verdict.rationale: IRCC's own site references representative accounts and forms, and offers a way to check whether a representative is authorized. That shows a first-party delegated-representative framework exists, but the evidence is limited to navigation links. Missing for 10: the specific authorization forms (e.g., use-of-representative form), a published definition of representative roles and their permitted or prohibited actions, which signatures or declarations must remain personal to the applicant, and any independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal

citations.quote: Accounts (GCKey, representatives, employers and more), biometrics, forms, change address
Check if your representative is authorized, report fraud or abuse
